Namaz mein ghaflat aur yateemon se nafrat: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum ne us shakhs ko dekha jo Qayamat ke din ko jo jaza-o-saza ka din hai jhutlata hai, yateem par zulm-o-sitam karta hai, us ka haq marta hai, us ke sath sulook-o-ehsan nahin karta, maskeenon ko khud to kya deta, dusron ko bhi is kar-e-khair par amada nahin karta. Jaise aur jagah hai (Kalla bal la tukrimoonal yateem - Surah Al-Fajr: 17) yani jo burai tumhein pahunchti hai woh tumhare aamal ka natija hai ke na tum yateemon ki izzat karte ho na maskeenon ko khana dene ki raghbat dilate ho, yani us faqeer ko jo itna nahin pata ke use kafi ho. Phir farman hota hai ke ghaflat baratne wale namaziyon ke liye 'Wail' hai, yani un munafiqon ke liye jo logon ke samne namaz ada karein warna hazam kar jayein. Yehi ma'ani Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke kiye hain aur ye bhi ma'ani hain ke muqarrar karda waqt taal dete hain, jaise ke Masroq aur Abu-ud-Duha kehte hain. Hazrat Ata bin Dinar farmate hain Allah ka shukr hai ke farman-e-Bari mein 'an salatihim' hai, 'fi salatihim' nahin, yani namazon se ghaflat karte hain, farmaya namazon mein ghaflat barat-te hain nahin farmaya. Isi tarah ye lafz shamil hai aise namazi ko bhi jo hamesha namaz ko aakhri waqt ada kare ya umooman aakhri waqt padhe ya arkan-o-shuroot ki poori riayat na kare ya khushu-o-khuzu aur tadabbur-o-ghaur-o-fikr na kare. Lafz-e-Quran in mein se har ek ko shamil hai. Ye sab baatein jis mein hon woh to poora poora badnaseeb hai aur jis mein jitni hon utna hi woh 'Wail' hai aur nifaq-e-amli ka haqdar hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Ye namaz munafiq ki hai, ye namaz munafiq ki hai, ye namaz munafiq ki hai ke baitha hua suraj ka intezar karta rahe, jab woh ghuroob hone ke qareeb pahunch jaye aur shaitan apne seeng us mein mila le to khada ho aur murgh ki tarah char thongein maar le, jis mein Allah ka zikr bahut hi kam kare. Yahan murad Asr ki namaz hai jo Salatul-Wusta hai, jaise ke hadith ke lafzon se sabit hai. Ye shakhs makrooh waqt mein khada hota aur kaway ki tarah chonchein maar leta hai jis mein itminan-e-arkan bhi nahin hota, na khushu-o-khuzu hota hai, balkay zikr-e-Allah bhi bahut hi kam hota hai aur kya ajab ke ye namaz mahaz dikhawe ki namaz ho to padhi na padhi yaksan hai. Inhi munafiqeen ke bare mein aur jagah irshad hai (Innal munafiqeena yukhadi'oonallaha wa huwa khadi'uhum, wa iza qamu ilas-salati qamu kusala yura'oonan-nasa wa la yazkuroonallaha illa qaleela - Surah An-Nisa: 142).

(An-Nisa: 142) Ya'ni munafiq Allah ko dhoka dete hain aur woh unhein, yeh jab bhi namaz ke liye khade hote hain toh thake haare badil-e-nakhwasta sirf logon ke dikhawe ke liye namaz guzaarte hain, Allah ki yaad bahut hi kam karte hain. Yahan bhi farmaya yeh riyakari karte hain, logon mein namazi bante hain. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai, 'Wail' jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis ki aag is qadar tez hai ke aur aag jahannam ki har din us se chaar sau martaba panah maangti hai. Yeh 'Wail' is ummat ke riyakar ulama ke liye hai aur riyakari ke taur par sadqa khairat karne walon ke liye hai aur riyakari ke taur par hajj karne walon ke liye hai aur riyakari ke taur par jihad karne walon ke liye hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, jo shakhs dusron ko sunane ke liye koi nek kaam kare, Allah Ta'ala bhi logon ko suna kar azab karega aur use zaleel-o-haqeer karega. Haan, is mauqa par yeh yaad rahe ke agar kisi shakhs ne bilkul nek niyati se koi achha kaam kiya aur logon ko is ki khabar ho gayi, is par use bhi khushi hui toh yeh riyakari nahin. Is ki daleel Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la Mosuli ki yeh hadith hai ke Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne sarkar-e-nabvi mein zikr kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main toh tanha nawafil padhta hoon lekin achanak koi aa jata hai toh zara mujhe bhi yeh achha maloom hone lagta hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tujhe do ajar milenge, ek ajar poshidgi ka aur dusra zahir karne ka. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mubarak farmaya karte the, yeh hadith riyakaron ke liye bhi achhi cheez hai. Yeh hadith baroye asnad ghareeb hai lekin isi ma'ni ki hadith aur sanad se bhi marvi hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ki ek bahut hi za'eef sanad wali hadith mein hai ke jab yeh aayat utri toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, Allahu Akbar, yeh tumhare liye behtar hai is se ke tum mein se har shakhs ko misl-e-tamam duniya ke diya jaye. Is se murad woh shakhs hai ke namaz padhe toh us ki bhalai se use kuch sarokar na ho aur na padhe toh Allah ka khauf use na ho. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ka matlab pucha gaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, yeh woh log hain jo namaz ko us ke waqt se mu'akhar karte hain. Is ke ek ma'ni toh yeh hain ke sire se padhte hi nahin, dusre ma'ni yeh hain ke shar'i waqt nikal dete hain phir padhte hain, yeh ma'ni bhi hain ke awwal waqt mein ada nahin karte. Ek mauqoof riwayat mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se marvi hai ke tang waqt kar daalte hain. Zyada sahih mauqoof riwayat hi hai, Imam Baihaqi bhi farmate hain ke marfoo toh za'eef hai haan mauqoof sahih hai, Imam Hakim ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Pas jis tarah yeh log ibadat-e-Rabb mein sust hain isi tarah logon ke huqooq bhi ada nahin karte, yahan tak ke baratne ki kam qeemat cheezein logon ko is liye bhi nahin dete ke woh apna kaam nikal lein aur phir woh cheez jyon ki tyon wapas kar dein. Pas in khasees logon se yeh kahan ban aaye ke woh zakat ada karein ya aur neki ke kaam karein. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se 'Ma'oon' ka matlab adaigi-e-zakat bhi marvi hai aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi aur deegar hazrat mufassireen-e-mo'tabareen se bhi. Imam Hassan Basri (R.H) farmate hain ke is ki namaz mein riyakari hai aur maal ke sadqa mein haath rokna hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain yeh munafiq log hain, namaz toh chunke zahir hai padhni padti hai aur zakat chunke posheeda hai is liye use ada nahin karte. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain, 'Ma'oon' har woh cheez hai jo log aapas mein ek dusre se maang liya karte hain jaise kadal, phawda, degchi, dol waghera.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ka yahi matlab bayan karte hain aur riwayat mein hai ke hum Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay aur hum is ki tafsir yahi karte thay. Nasai ki hadith mein hai har neki cheez sadaqa hai, dol aur handiya ya patili mangay par dene ko hum An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein Ma'oon se ta'beer karte thay. Garz is ke ma'ni zakat na dene ke, ita'at na karne ke, mangi cheez na dene ke hain. Choti choti be-jan cheezein koi do ghari ke liye mangne aaye us se un ka inkar kar dena, maslan chalni, dol, sui, sil-batta, kadal, pha'ora, patili, degchi wagaira. Ek gharib hadith mein hai ke qabila-e-Numair ke wafd ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hamein khas hukum kya hota hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ma'oon se mana karna. Unhon ne poocha Ma'oon kya? Farmaya patthar, loha, pani. Unhon ne poocha lohay se murad kaunsa loha hai? Farmaya yahi tumhari tanbay ki patiliyan aur kadal wagaira. Poocha patthar se kya murad? Farmaya yahi degchi wagaira. Yeh hadith bohat hi gharib hai, balkay marfoo hona munkar hai aur is ki asnad mein woh rawi hain jo mashhoor nahin. Ali Numairi farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne suna hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya musalman ka musalman bhai hai, jab milay salam kare, jab salam kare to behtar jawab de aur Ma'oon ka inkar na kare. Main ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Ma'oon kya? Farmaya patthar, loha aur isi jaisi aur cheezein. Wallahu A'lam. Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se, us ke ehsan aur raham se is surat ki tafsir bhi khatam hui.
